test_case.test_name: Parameterized AMDSST8-hour85%-memory health stress with FPU and AVT telemetry
test_case.purpose: Stress memory at the approved85% target for eight hours with FPU load while verifying ECC, OOM, responsiveness, power and thermal health.
required_package: Licensed checksum-pinned AMDSST/SystemStress and AVT/AVTCMD builds plus vendor docs
Vendor-validated8h modules/FPU/memoryusage=85 syntax and absolute tool paths
Operator stop, tracked cleanup, restoration and invalid-run policy
test_case.test_command: Validate signed licensed packages, supported options and their installed absolute paths; preserve baseline OS/BMC/ECC evidence; start timestamped AVT PMM/thermal telemetry before launching the reviewed AMDSST8h memory85%+FPU profile once; monitor memory pressure, ECC/OOM/watchdog and responsiveness; abort on any approved gate; preserve complete outputs and restore recorded settings.
test_case.expected_result: The full eight-hour memory profile completes without disallowed ECC/OOM/watchdog/system errors, telemetry remains valid and within limits, and the SUT stays responsive.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires exact8h/85%-memory/FPU coverage, continuous PMM/thermal and memory-health evidence, and every approved limit. Help output, a smoke run or threshold-free result cannot pass.
safety_gate: No stress before licensed package/platform/path and thresholds are approved.
Preserve logs; never clear baseline evidence.
Abort on ECC, OOM/swap instability, watchdog, telemetry loss, thermal or power limits.
Track every process; no automatic reboot, recovery or rerun.
expected_evidence: Exact command, full8h output, timestamps and exit/abort state
AVT PMM/die-temperature time series with units
Baseline/final OS/BMC logs, cleanup/restoration and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On ECC growth, OOM, telemetry loss or power/thermal breach, terminate only tracked AMDSST/AVT processes, preserve the synchronized memory/PMM/thermal/error window, restore recorded policies, verify DIMM/channel health and require memory-owner authorization before any new full-duration run.
